import subprocess,re,os,json
paths=set(filter(None,subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z']).decode().split('\0')))|set(filter(None,subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','-z']).decode().split('\0')))
rx=re.compile(r'(?i)(?:api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|refresh[_-]?token|client[_-]?secret)[\\"\s:=]+([A-Za-z0-9_./+-]{32,})');found=[]
for p in paths:
 if not os.path.isfile(p):continue
 try:s=open(p).read()
 except(UnicodeError,IsADirectoryError):continue
 for m in rx.finditer(s):
  if len(set(m.group(1)))>12:found.append({'path':p,'offset':m.start(),'kind':'credential-shaped field'})
print('additional credential-shaped findings',len(found));print(json.dumps(found[:8]))
json.dump(found,open('.local/seven-smart-2026-10-20/credential-fields.json','w'))
